item.title: Gorse Unauthenticated Database Dump and Restore via Empty Admin API Key (CVE-2026-56782)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-56782 (VulnCheck advisory: Gorse unauthenticated database dump and restore). Status: Weaponized. Affects: Gorse recommender system, master HTTP service and dashboard (default port 8088). Tags: Gorse, recommender system, authentication bypass, missing authentication, CWE-306, REST API, Go, database dump, data poisoning, unauthenticated.
